name: PowOS desktop home (powos-shell)
purpose: PAUSED by the user 2026-10-22 (autostart disabled with powos-desktop-shell disable, not running; code kept). The web shell's home (grid, widgets, PowOS AI's pill and chat, the pet) as a layer surface under every window of the phone's Plasma session, beside plasmashell. Starts with the Plasma session; powos-desktop-shell start|stop|status|enable|disable. Built on the phone from the repo by sources/powos-shell/dev/phone.sh build against the rootfs's own Qt/QtWebEngine/LayerShellQt (no packages installed).

processes.name: powos-shell home (+ QtWebEngineProcess zygotes, renderer, GPU)
processes.started_by: the Plasma session's XDG autostart (/etc/xdg/autostart/powos-desktop-shell.desktop: powos-desktop-shell start --auto), or powos-desktop-shell start; powos-desktop-shell disable turns the autostart off

remove: powos-desktop-shell disable; rm -f /etc/xdg/autostart/powos-desktop-shell.desktop; rm -rf /usr/lib/powos/desktop-shell /usr/bin/powos-desktop-shell /usr/share/applications/org.powos.shell.desktop /var/tmp/powos-shell-src /var/tmp/powos-shell-build /home/powos/.local/share/powos-shell /home/powos/.cache/powos-shell /home/powos/.local/share/powos/net (host.net's pins and app secrets) (shell-data's desktop-* files are the desktop's layout and chat)
